reviewedRange: First eleven complete move judgments; sufficient to establish recurring failure without reading remaining prose for acceptance.

violations.finding: The revision still mechanically wraps the same per-move strength and limitation in six fixed templates, merely naming distinct consequences without demonstrating them. Clear statements are described as requiring reconstruction solely because support is incomplete; route relevance and responsiveness inherit unrelated inference defects.

Templates claim evidence is strong because a limitation exists and treat failure to prove every experience false as part of a live challenge left unanswered. The critical burden does not require universal falsity.
